title: Two-Sided Plausibility Constraints in Persuasion
abstract: arXiv:2610.13702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A sender with commitment provides additional information to an already informed receiver. Final posterior means must be more dispersed than initial means and less dispersed than the state, in convex order. We characterize when these two plausibility constraints are also sufficient, so that every distribution satisfying them can be induced. If the state has a positive density, they are sufficient exactly under interval-partition information: the receiver learns which interval of a partition contains the state and nothing more, where an interval may be a single point. Otherwise, a nonempty open set of distributions satisfying both constraints cannot be induced, even when the sender observes the receiver's information. We use the sufficient case to derive an optimal symmetric disclosure rule in a second-price auction where bidders initially know valuation intervals.

translated_title: 说服中的双侧合理性约束
translated_abstract: 一个具有承诺能力的发送者向已经拥有信息的接收者提供额外信息。在凸序意义下，最终的后验均值必须比初始均值更分散，同时又比状态本身更不分散。我们刻画了这两条合理性约束何时也是充分的条件，即每一个满足这两条约束的分布都可以被诱导出来。当状态具有正密度时，这两条约束恰好仅在区间分割信息结构下是充分的：接收者只了解到状态位于某个分割的哪个区间之中，除此之外一无所知，且区间可以是单点。在其他情形下，即使发送者能够观察到接收者的信息，一个满足两条约束的非空开集分布仍然无法被诱导。我们利用充分性的情形，推导出在投标者最初只知估值区间的第二价格拍卖中的最优对称披露规则。
tldr: 本文刻画了信息设计（说服）中“后验均值须比先验均值更分散、比状态更不分散”这一双侧合理性约束何时为充分条件——当状态具有正密度时恰在区间分割信息下充分——并据此推导了投标者初始只知估值区间的第二价格拍卖中的最优对称披露规则。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when the two-sided plausibility constraints in persuasion (posterior means more dispersed than priors but less dispersed than the state, in convex order) are sufficient—exactly under interval-partition information when the state has positive density—and uses this to derive an optimal symmetric disclosure rule for second-price auctions where bidders initially know only valuation intervals.
